feeds.title: Conservative Momma
feeds.description: Rachel, 'Conservative Momma' is the primary contributor and founder of ConservativeMomma.com, a site that speaks up and speaks out for the Conservative cause. Rachel is a vlogger, blogger, speaker, commentator and political strategist who actively engages other individuals online through social media.

feeds.title: Chicks On The Right
feeds.description: The website chicksontheright.com was launched on February 27, 2009. Ever since, the Chicks' mission has been to advance the cause of conservatism through data-driven and opinion-driven commentary in an informal and entertaining way.

feeds.title: Moms Rising Together Blog » Politics & Policy
feeds.description: MomsRising combines the best of American innovation and ingenuity. We are a transformative on-the-ground and online multicultural organization of more than a million members and over a hundred aligned organizations working to increase family economic security, to end discrimination against women and mothers, and to build a nation where both businesses and families can thrive.

feeds.title: Scunchy Conservative Mom Blog
feeds.description: Scrunchy conservative mom online blog promoting non-toxic living, homeschool, and homesteading. Balancing ancestral with modern technology to achieve a common sense lifestyle.

feeds.title: Politics For Her Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers diverse categories such as Lifestyle, Mom Life, Style, and Gift Guides, blending politically minded commentary with relatable content like parenting stories and outfit inspiration.

feeds.title: It's Only Words
feeds.description: It's Only Words used to spend her days like other grandmothers, baking pies and crocheting doilies. Then one day she noticed the Constitution was taking a beating and going down fast. Now she uses the only weapon at her disposal to preserve, defend and protect. Check out her articles on conservative side stories, opinions and more!

feeds.title: The Real Deal of Parenting
feeds.description: The Real Deal of Parenting is the #1 Christian conservative parenting platform run by owners Abby Johnson and Regan Long. The Real Deal of Parenting, covers all things pertaining to motherhood, with authenticity, insight, and a healthy dose of humor. They present topics from a Christian perspective ranging from the everyday challenges of raising kids of all ages to high-profile issues and current events facing families.
